EXERCISE — FICTIONAL

1. Collection against the Ostrand Peninsula during the reporting period establishes that two AIS identities broadcast from the same position within four minutes.

2. Entities identified in this reporting: Stellar Vane, Mirenda.

3. The activity was passed at 1036Z and repeated at 1514Z. No further traffic on the subject was recovered before collection ended at 0910Z.

4. Traffic volume rose to approximately 5 transmissions per hour against a normal baseline of 5, without corresponding change in content.

5. The reporting establishes that the activity occurred but not why it was ordered.

6. ANALYST COMMENT: Graded A1; credibility reflects independent corroboration by another discipline rather than the source's own consistency.
